summary: A hiker became lost while downclimbing in Blanca Creek Basin below the Little Bear-Blanca traverse, then developed severe dehydration and hypothermia; an overnight delay preceded helicopter insertion; emergency Hover STEP extraction and hospital flight.
location: Blanca Creek Basin, below Little Bear-Blanca traverse
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR, Costilla and Alamosa County sheriffs, Canon City Helitack/DFPC, Lifeline5, REACH 29
notes: Dehydration/hypothermia secondary to being lost; classified lost/stranded. AVSAR primary-source mission report. County spans Costilla/Alamosa response area. Corroborating Alamosa Citizen NVG story: this night-search mission (hypothermic/dehydrated hiker rescued at first light) motivated AVSAR's night-vision-goggle purchase.
